findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_video" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_video" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
